Small gardens, big ideas

We design and plant gardens under a quarter of an acre: courtyards, terraced plots and family lawns that need to work hard.

How we work

  1. A site visit and a conversation about how you use the space.
  2. A measured plan and planting list, with two rounds of changes.
  3. Planting by our own team, or a list for you to plant yourself.
